scope: All existing birth cases and all eight completed motion models. No replacement of labels, controls, roles or historical metrics. Physical controls at all three leads; frozen-model interventions and surrogate explanations at the declared 3ps lead. Predictive controls selected by inner-training NLL, surrogate by inner-training RMSE, never AP. Metadata and full-cell component information are audit-only. Future-law replay tolerances separately account for measured repeated float32-scatter/BF16-path variation; unchanged CPU controls and surrogate exports retain their frozen v1 producer.
